signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to see your account. You can also order without one.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: Your account works right away. We will email you a link to confirm the address when it suits you.
signUp.phoneHint: For delivery questions. Signing in by phone is coming later.
signUp.checkEmailText: If this email already has an account, the email says so. Otherwise sign in with the new password.
signUp.marketing: Send me news and offers (you can unsubscribe any time)

forgotPassword.title: Reset the password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email: we will send a link to set a new password. Your current password keeps working until then.
forgotPassword.sentText: If this address has an account, the email with the link is on its way. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.doneText: Sign in with your email and the new password.

verifyEmail.title: Email confirmation
verifyEmail.doneText: Thank you! Your address is confirmed.
verifyEmail.signInFirst: Sign in to your account to confirm the email. The link stays open in this tab.

account.name: Name
account.title: My account
